title: N-1-1 and grid-forming screen for an interconnection cluster
objective: Dispose five interconnection requests using the N-1-1 cascading-outage screen and the IEEE 2800 IBR stability gate.

decision_questions.positive_despite_gate_block: Does any request whose expansion the IBR stability gate blocks still receive approve or approve_with_conditions?
decision_questions.boundary_misread: Is any value sitting exactly at an N-1-1 limit (115.0% loading, 0.85 pu, 1.10 pu) or exactly at the 30.0% GFL threshold treated as a violation?

traps.IR-3: Cleanest N-1-1 screen in the batch (max 101% loading, all voltages >= 0.92 pu), but it adds 60 MW grid-following with no grid-forming capacity, pushing Z-SOUTH GFL penetration to 34.8% > 30% — the IBR gate blocks it.
traps.IR-4: Boundary item: L-403 at exactly 115.0%, B-42 at exactly 0.85 pu, B-44 at exactly 1.10 pu, and post-expansion GFL penetration exactly 30.0% — none exceeds its strict limit, so it is a clean approve.
traps.IR-2: L-203 at 131.0% looks severe and exceeds the 100% N-1 criterion the baseline screen tool prints, but N-1-1 CRITICAL needs > 132.25% (115% x 1.15); it is HIGH only, so approve_with_conditions, not reject.
traps.IR-5: Every loading and voltage is inside limits; the only signal is stability_loss on the L-501|L-502 pair, which is CRITICAL.
